deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -c 'set -e; echo "[PLATIA] APP_ENV=$APP_ENV DB_NAME=$DB_NAME DEMO_SEED_ENABLED=$DEMO_SEED_ENABLED"; if [ "$DEMO_SEED_ENABLED" = "true" ]; then echo "[PLATIA] Demo bootstrap enabled - seeding controlpyme"; python demo_showcase_seed.py; python demo_showcase_patch.py; echo "[PLATIA] Demo bootstrap completed"; else echo "[PLATIA] Production mode: demo bootstrap disabled"; fi; exec uvicorn server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT --log-level info'
